generation.scope: A singular finite eight-cofactor member, including nodal order two, must have a positive-dimensional common-cubic degeneracy. All fifteen binary-quintic Pfaffians vanish scheme-theoretically on the point window, with span at most fourteen and a bound depending on conductor length. Away from proportional pairs the residual cubic and scalar incidence lift also on nonreduced supports.

open_mathematics: Study the excess degeneracy curves and the proportional conductor points on singular finite members. Investigate the smooth-quadric and quadric-cone alternatives for nine cofactors as well as general-window coverage.
